text:
alex: Good morning — planning progressive rollout for v2.14.0 across US/EU/APAC. Start US canary 10% -> 30% over 30m, then EU, then APAC. Need capacity thumbs and pin decisions.
maya: +1. What's the pinned model version? We should pin to 2.14.0-rc3 and keep fallback to 2.13.8.
alex: Pin 2.14.0-rc3 for the rollout routes. Fallback policy -> auto-failover to 2.13.8 if latency > 700ms p95 for 3 consecutive minutes.
jin: APAC cluster reported high kernel contention earlier. Ops has a thermal soft cap at 75% GPU util on night shift.
ops-bot: Snapshot: US warm-pool 120 instances, EU warm-pool 48 instances, APAC warm-pool 22 instances. Current surge cushion: US 40%, EU 25%, APAC 8%.
maya: APAC cushion is tight. Can we route APAC small canary at local timezone midnight? Maybe move APAC later.
oncall_sre: I'd prefer APAC last. Suggest US -> EU -> APAC. Add a holdpoint after EU for 45m to verify KV cache hit ratio and token latency.
alex: Agreed. Plan: US canary 10% -> 30% over 20m; wait 10m; EU canary 10% -> 25% over 25m; hold 45m; APAC 5% -> 20% over 30m (delayed by 6h).
deploy-bot: /deploy release v2.14.0 --regions us --slice 10 --pin v2.14.0-rc3
deploy-bot: deploy started: job id 31722, eta 2m. Health checks: warmup, model-load, kv-cache-init.
ops-bot: Preflight checks passed for US: model-load latencies OK, prefix cache available, warp-gpu kernel selection good.
maya: Note: rolling change window ends 23:00 UTC. We'll stop increases if any error spikes or if cost per-token > baseline*1.25.
jin: If EU cache pressure spikes, fallback trigger should be immediate pin to 2.13.8 for EU routes. Ops to execute manual-pin if needed.
oncall_sre: Oncall will watch p95, error-rate, and throttled-queue. Escalate if throttled-queue > 5% for 5m.
alex: Post-deploy checklist: update release notes (api changelog), notify partners, trigger smoke-evals on critical prompt sets.
maya: I've queued smoke-evals. Also enabling conservative batching in US for first hour: batch_max_tokens=1024 -> 512.
deploy-bot: job 31722: canary slice increased to 30% (US). Observability: p95=180ms, error-rate=0.04%.
ops-bot: US capacity headroom now 28% under target SLO. EU rollouts can start when warm-pool >= 40 instances.
oncall_sre: Launch EU canary in 10m if warm-pool reaches target. Monitoring alert channel: #eng-oncall.
jin: APAC warmup plan: pre-start 8 extra instances in tokyo region 4h before traffic. Ops please confirm.
ops-bot: Confirmed: APAC prestart scheduled +8 instances at 2026-03-21T02:00:00Z.
alex: If any region hits rollback criteria (p95>700ms 3min OR error-rate>0.5% 5min OR throttled>5% 5min) -> immediate manual rollback to 2.13.8 and pin.
maya: Copy. I'll prepare the rollback command and a short release-note blurb.
alex: Thanks all. I'll post final notes to #release-notes and ping CS. Holdpoint after EU begins at 2765432140; please only reply there for go/no-go.
maya: Go for EU from me if holdpoint looks green.
oncall_sre: Oncall observing. I'll post status updates at the holdpoint.
ops-bot: Holdpoint reached: EU canary started slice 10% -> increasing per plan. warm-pool=52, cache hit 91%.
alex: EU looks green, thumbs from SRE and DevEx? :thumbsup:
maya: :thumbsup:
jin: :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: job 31722: EU slice now 25%.
ops-bot: EU observability: p95=220ms, errors=0.06%, token-cost delta +3%.
alex: Proceed to APAC after scheduled delay. Remember APAC has thermal cap, keep slice ramp conservative.
ops-bot: APAC prestart finished. warm-pool=30 (includes +8). Surge cushion 15%.
oncall_sre: Monitoring APAC closely. Launching APAC canary at low-business window.
deploy-bot: /deploy release v2.14.0 --regions apac --slice 5 --pin v2.14.0-rc3
deploy-bot: job 31722: APAC canary slice 5% started. Observability: p95=250ms, errors=0.03%.
ops-bot: APAC thermal margin at 72% (soft cap 75%). All good but no further auto-increases.
alex: All regions ramped. Summary for release notes: pinned v2.14.0-rc3, fallback to v2.13.8, holdpoints at EU, rollback criteria spelled out, APAC delayed due to thermal limits.
maya: I'll push release notes now and tag partners. Closing thread after final metrics in 1h.
ops-bot: Final snapshot (1m): US p95=185ms, EU p95=215ms, APAC p95=248ms, global errors avg=0.045%.
alex: Nice job team. :rocket:
